lines.zh: 我沿着村里的石板路走。
lines.en: I walk along the village's stone path.

lines.zh: 我的脚踩过菜地，菜都枯了。
lines.en: My feet cross the garden patch; every plant is dead.

lines.zh: 我走过空掉的房子，一间一间。
lines.en: I pass the emptied houses, one after another.

lines.zh: 我拖着长袍，下摆全是灰。
lines.en: I drag my robe, its hem covered in ash.

lines.zh: 我走得像在数步子。
lines.en: I walk as if counting each step.

lines.zh: 夜里我走遍村子，不敲门。
lines.en: At night I walk the whole village and knock nowhere.

lines.zh: 我绕开井，井里有股味道。
lines.en: I go around the well; something smells down there.

lines.zh: 我走过钟楼，停了一下。
lines.en: I pass the bell tower and pause.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，像怕吵醒谁。
lines.en: My steps are light, as if afraid to wake someone.

lines.zh: 我走不回自己的家，它塌了。
lines.en: I cannot walk home; my house has fallen in.

lines.zh: 我沿着篱笆走，篱笆歪着。
lines.en: I follow the fence, and the fence leans crooked.

lines.zh: 我走来走去，等天亮。
lines.en: I pace back and forth, waiting for dawn.

lines.zh: 我站在广场中央，看着钟。
lines.en: I stand in the square, looking at the bell.

lines.zh: 我低着头，手在袖子里发抖。
lines.en: I keep my head down, hands trembling in my sleeves.

lines.zh: 我听见风穿过空窗。
lines.en: I hear wind moving through empty windows.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，像在等一句话。
lines.en: I stand still, as if waiting for one sentence.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸门框，指印是黑的。
lines.en: I touch the door frame and leave a black print.

lines.zh: 我不坐下，我怕坐下就散。
lines.en: I do not sit; I fear sitting will scatter me.

lines.zh: 我数着还亮着的窗，只有两扇。
lines.en: I count lit windows: only two.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，只呼出一口凉气。
lines.en: I open my mouth and only cold air comes out.

lines.zh: 我盯着火把，火苗在抖。
lines.en: I stare at the torch, and its flame trembles.

lines.zh: 远处有狗叫，我转过身去。
lines.en: A dog barks far off, and I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 你走过来，我慢慢抬起头。
lines.en: You walk over; I raise my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我看着你，眼睛很干。
lines.en: I look at you with eyes that are very dry.

lines.zh: 你身上没有这里的味道。
lines.en: You do not smell of this place.

lines.zh: 我盯着你腰上的钟，你带了吗。
lines.en: I stare at your belt: did you bring a bell?

lines.zh: 你的眉毛，像我打过招呼的人。
lines.en: Your brow looks like someone I used to greet.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里没有话，只有一口气。
lines.en: Nothing is left in my throat but one cold breath.

lines.zh: 你的火把照出我的影子。
lines.en: Your torch throws my shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里找一点熟悉。
lines.en: I search your eyes for something familiar.

lines.zh: 你停在钟楼前，我停在门边。
lines.en: You halt before the bell tower; I halt by the door.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，然后低头。
lines.en: I look at you a long while, then bow my head.

lines.zh: 你的刀穿过去，我一点事都没有。
lines.en: Your blade passes through and nothing happens to me.

lines.zh: 我被打中，却像隔着一层水。
lines.en: I am struck, yet it feels like water between us.

lines.zh: 剑砍在我身上，只带起一片灰。
lines.en: The sword hits me and only raises a puff of ash.

lines.zh: 你的武器伤不到我，别浪费。
lines.en: Your weapon cannot hurt me; do not waste it.

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，疼的是记忆。
lines.en: I take the blow, and it is memory that aches.

lines.zh: 刀锋过去，我的身体又合上。
lines.en: The edge passes and my body closes again.

lines.zh: 你砍了三次，我还站着。
lines.en: You have cut me three times and I am still standing.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的袍子划开了。
lines.en: That one split my robe open.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，那里什么都没有。
lines.en: I look down at the wound; there is nothing there.

lines.zh: 我不怕刀，我怕天亮。
lines.en: I do not fear blades; I fear sunrise.

lines.zh: 你递来面包，我没有伸手。
lines.en: You hold out bread; I do not reach for it.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我缺的是钟声。
lines.en: I am not hungry; what I lack is a bell.

lines.zh: 你把绿宝石放在我面前。
lines.en: You set emeralds down in front of me.

lines.zh: 我摇头，钱救不了这个村。
lines.en: I shake my head; money cannot save this village.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃手里的东西，很轻。
lines.en: You shake what you hold; it is light.

lines.zh: 交易早停了，铺子都空了。
lines.en: Trading stopped long ago; the shops are empty.

lines.zh: 我想要的，你一只手拿不动。
lines.en: What I want cannot be carried in one hand.

lines.zh: 食物离我太远了。
lines.en: Food is far beyond me now.

lines.zh: 你给什么都行，除了时间。
lines.en: Give me anything but time.

lines.zh: 别喂我，去找那口钟。
lines.en: Do not feed me; go find the bell.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我从你身上穿了一点。
lines.en: You bump me, and part of me passes through you.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的手穿进你的胸口。
lines.en: We collide, and my hand passes into your chest.

lines.zh: 你推我，我晃了晃没倒。
lines.en: You push me; I sway but do not fall.

lines.zh: 碰到你时，我才想起自己多重。
lines.en: Touching you reminds me how heavy I am.

lines.zh: 我贴着你站，你比我还冷。
lines.en: I stand against you, and you are colder than me.

lines.zh: 你从我身边挤过去，我没有让。
lines.en: You squeeze past me, and I do not step aside.

lines.zh: 撞开的时候，我掉了半片指甲。
lines.en: As we part, half a nail flakes off me.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的冷会留在你衣上。
lines.en: Not too close; my cold will cling to your clothes.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的袍角，布碎了一地。
lines.en: You step on my hem, and the cloth crumbles.

lines.zh: 这一撞，让我的脸更清楚了。
lines.en: That collision makes my face clearer.

lines.zh: 这村里没有人和我成家。
lines.en: No one in this village is left to marry me.

lines.zh: 我的妻子孩子，都在那面墙后。
lines.en: My wife and children are behind that wall now.

lines.zh: 我早就没有这个念想了。
lines.en: That wish left me long ago.

lines.zh: 你若问伴，我只剩影子。
lines.en: If you ask about company, I have only my shadow.

lines.zh: 我们本该在春天办喜事。
lines.en: We were to be wed in spring.

lines.zh: 活着的人才谈这些。
lines.en: Only the living talk of such things.

lines.zh: 我看着别人家的窗，看了很久。
lines.en: I look at other houses' windows for a long time.

lines.zh: 我的手太冷，牵不住谁。
lines.en: My hands are too cold to hold anyone's.

lines.zh: 这个村子已经没有婴儿哭了。
lines.en: No baby cries in this village anymore.

lines.zh: 若要人陪，我宁愿要个敲钟的。
lines.en: For company, I would rather have a bell ringer.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块碎瓦，放进口袋。
lines.en: I pick up a broken tile and put it in my pocket.

lines.zh: 地上有孩子的鞋，我拿起来。
lines.en: A child's shoe lies there; I pick it up.

lines.zh: 我捡起一把断掉的锄头。
lines.en: I pick up a broken hoe.

lines.zh: 我捡起面包，又放回台阶上。
lines.en: I pick up bread, then set it back on the step.

lines.zh: 我从灰里捡出一枚铜币。
lines.en: I pick a copper coin out of the ash.

lines.zh: 我捡起碎玻璃，指头没破。
lines.en: I pick up broken glass and my finger does not cut.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的钟舌塞进怀里。
lines.en: I tuck the clapper I found against my chest.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根蜡烛，它灭着。
lines.en: I pick up a candle; its flame is out.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡东西时，雾散了一点。
lines.en: As I bend to pick something up, the fog thins.

lines.zh: 我不捡贵重东西，只捡旧物。
lines.en: I take nothing valuable, only old things.

lines.zh: 你走进了这个村，我看向你。
lines.en: You enter this village, and I look at you.

lines.zh: 我听见了活人的脚步。
lines.en: I hear the footsteps of someone alive.

lines.zh: 我朝你走，不是要伤你。
lines.en: I walk toward you, not to hurt you.

lines.zh: 你身上有钟楼的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of the bell tower.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，因为你会动。
lines.en: I follow you because you can still move.

lines.zh: 我一发现你，就不想再一个人。
lines.en: The moment I find you, I do not want to be alone.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝转向你的方向。
lines.en: My eye sockets turn toward you.

lines.zh: 你手里亮着，我就朝亮处去。
lines.en: You carry light; I go toward it.

lines.zh: 我认下你，像认下一根绳子。
lines.en: I take hold of you like a rope.

lines.zh: 你别跑，我不是来追的。
lines.en: Do not run; I am not chasing you.

lines.zh: 看到你，我就想起还有人活着。
lines.en: Seeing you reminds me someone is still alive.

lines.zh: 你来的这刻，夜短了一点。
lines.en: The night got a little shorter when you came.

lines.zh: 我选了你，因为你是唯一的人。
lines.en: I chose you because you are the only one here.

lines.zh: 我的手指指向你，又垂下。
lines.en: My finger points at you, then drops.

lines.zh: 你打翻了门口的灯，我就跟上了。
lines.en: You knocked over the lamp at the gate, so I followed.

lines.zh: 我一直跟着你，不远不近。
lines.en: I keep following you, neither near nor far.

lines.zh: 你去看钟楼，我走在你旁边。
lines.en: You head for the bell tower; I walk beside you.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也停下等你。
lines.en: You stop, and I stop to wait.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看你要不要敲。
lines.en: I watch your hand, waiting to see if you ring.

lines.zh: 你走近钟，我的心跳了一下。
lines.en: You near the bell, and something in me jumps.

lines.zh: 我把你往钟那边带。
lines.en: I steer you toward the bell.

lines.zh: 你拐进小巷，我跟进去。
lines.en: You turn into an alley, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我挡在门口，怕你走掉。
lines.en: I block the doorway, afraid you will leave.

lines.zh: 你在钟绳前犹豫，我屏住呼吸。
lines.en: You hesitate at the rope and I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 我跟着你绕了整个村子。
lines.en: I follow you all the way around the village.

lines.zh: 你抬头看钟，我也抬头。
lines.en: You look up at the bell; so do I.

lines.zh: 我离你四十八格，刚好够。
lines.en: I stay forty-eight blocks away, close enough.

lines.zh: 我从窗子里看着你走过去。
lines.en: I watch you pass by through the window.

lines.zh: 你要走，我就站在路中间。
lines.en: If you try to leave, I stand in the road.

lines.zh: 我把你往钟楼引，你跟着我走。
lines.en: I lead you toward the bell tower, and you follow.

lines.zh: 你手上有绳子，我看出来了。
lines.en: You have a rope in your hand. I noticed.

lines.zh: 我站在路中央，你绕不过去。
lines.en: I stand in the middle of the road; you cannot go around.

lines.zh: 你回头看了三次，我一直在。
lines.en: You looked back three times. I was always there.

lines.zh: 我抬手打你，手却穿过去了。
lines.en: I swing at you, and my hand passes through.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，只抓到灰。
lines.en: I grab your collar and catch only dust.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落在你身上，没有重量。
lines.en: My fist lands on you with no weight at all.

lines.zh: 我推你，你的肩只凉了一块。
lines.en: I push you, and one spot on your shoulder chills.

lines.zh: 我打你，像打一口空锅。
lines.en: Hitting you is like hitting an empty pot.

lines.zh: 我一挥，袖子散了半截。
lines.en: I swing, and half my sleeve falls away.

lines.zh: 我掐你的脖子，你还能呼吸。
lines.en: I grip your throat, and you can still breathe.

lines.zh: 我的指甲划过护甲，没有痕。
lines.en: My nails rake your armor and leave no mark.

lines.zh: 我撞你，你退了一步，仅此而已。
lines.en: I ram you; you step back once, nothing more.

lines.zh: 我打不疼你，我早就知道。
lines.en: I cannot hurt you; I have known that a while.

lines.zh: 我抬手的姿势，还记着怎么打人。
lines.en: My raised hand still remembers how to strike.

lines.zh: 我的手掌从你的胸口穿过去。
lines.en: My palm passes straight through your chest.

lines.zh: 我打你时，比被打还难受。
lines.en: Striking you feels worse than being struck.

lines.zh: 这一下用完了我今晚的力气。
lines.en: That swing used up tonight's strength.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子，那里空了一块。
lines.en: I grab your sleeve, and a piece of it is missing.

lines.zh: 我抬手，风从我袖子里穿过去。
lines.en: I raise my hand, and wind passes through my sleeve.

lines.zh: 夜里，我从村口的雾里出来。
lines.en: At night I come out of the fog at the village gate.

lines.zh: 村子被侵袭过，我留下来。
lines.en: The village was raided, and I stayed behind.

lines.zh: 我出现在广场，没有人迎我。
lines.en: I appear in the square and no one greets me.

lines.zh: 天黑以后，我才敢站在这。
lines.en: Only after dark do I dare stand here.

lines.zh: 我从倒塌的墙后走出来。
lines.en: I step out from behind a fallen wall.

lines.zh: 我一出现，灯火就暗了一点。
lines.en: When I appear, the lamplight dims a little.

lines.zh: 我记得这里，这里不记得我。
lines.en: I remember this place; it does not remember me.

lines.zh: 我站在自家的门槛外。
lines.en: I stand outside my own doorstep.

lines.zh: 雾散时，我已经在路上了。
lines.en: When the fog lifts, I am already on the road.

lines.zh: 我出现时，钟楼静得很。
lines.en: As I appear, the bell tower is very quiet.

lines.zh: 我从土里、从墙上、从影子里来。
lines.en: I come from soil, from walls, from shadows.

lines.zh: 村子空了，我就来了。
lines.en: The village emptied, so I came.

lines.zh: 火能烧到我，我在火里喊了一声。
lines.en: Fire can reach me; I cry out inside it.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，落地时散了一半。
lines.en: I fall and half of me scatters on landing.

lines.zh: 水把我泡软，我在井里沉下去。
lines.en: Water softens me and I sink down the well.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹散，又被风吹回来。
lines.en: The blast scatters me, and the wind brings me back.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，钉在后面的门上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through me and sticks in the door.

lines.zh: 魔法的光碰到我，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Magic light touches me and I shudder.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西很久了，只剩空壳。
lines.en: I have not eaten in ages; only a shell remains.

lines.zh: 雷照亮整个村，我几乎透明。
lines.en: Lightning lights the village and I am almost transparent.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拉走，没人敲钟。
lines.en: The void pulls me under, and no one rings the bell.
